one_line_answer.text: CBT places emphasis on what a person can do in the workplace after training.

cites.quote: Competency based training (CBT) places emphasis on what a person can do in the workplace as a result of completing a training program.

bangla_explanation: CBT-তে আসল প্রশ্ন: training শেষে workplace-এ লোকটা কী করতে পারে।
Program modules দিয়ে তৈরি, আর modules ভাগ হয় learning outcomes-এ।
Modules industry standards-এর ওপর ভিত্তি করে বানানো।
Progress সময়ের ওপর নির্ভর করে না; module শেষ হলেই পরের module-এ যাওয়া যায়।

example.en: A fast learner in a plumbing course finishes module 1 early. He moves straight to module 2.
example.bn: প্লাম্বিং কোর্সে যে আগে module শেষ করে, সে আগেই পরের module-এ যায়।

short.prompt: How do you define a competency based training program?
short.modelAnswer:
Competency based training (CBT) places emphasis on what a person can do in the workplace after a training program.
1. CBT programs have modules broken into learning outcomes.
2. Modules are based on industry standards.
3. Assessment ensures each student achieves all module outcomes.
4. Progress is not based on time.
5. Some programs have fixed timeframes, and on and off the job parts.

keyPoints.text: Competency is a broad concept, not only narrow skills.

cites.quote: Competency is a broad concept that includes all aspects of work performance and not only narrow skills.

keyPoints.text: Students may be able to complete a program of study quickly.

cites.quote: therefore they may be able to complete a program of study quickly.
